docs.text: Let mud settle. Pour the clear water through a clean cloth. Then disinfect. Dose is not a substitute for settling. Source: EPA emergency disinfection guidance.

Regular liquid household bleach, no scent, no color-safe additive. Clear water: 8 drops per gallon, or 2 drops per quart (about 1/8 teaspoon per gallon). Double if cloudy. Stir. Stand 30 minutes. Slight chlorine smell should remain; if not, repeat and stand another 15 minutes. Source: EPA emergency disinfection.
Five drops of 2% U.S.P. tincture of iodine per quart or liter of clear water. Ten drops if cloudy. Stand at least 30 minutes. Source: EPA emergency disinfection.

Chemical disinfection does not remove fuel, metals, or salt. Seawater is not a drink. Boil-minute counts and filter brand claims are a gap on the Water card; Lifeline holds field-manual chapters. Source: TRU Water lane law.
Emergency disinfection only. Clear the dirt first. No invented dose. Full lane: splashdown1/tru-water.
